prompt: Create a vertical, hyperrealistic summer fantasy beverage advertisement scene: an extreme close-up of a tall transparent glass filled with sparkling emerald-green soda, crushed ice, bubbles, condensation droplets, and glossy lime-like highlights, sitting on a bright sandy beach. From the drink rises a miniature icy arctic world: one translucent blue ice whale breaching dramatically from the soda with its head and body arcing upward, water splashes and droplets frozen midair, and fine glowing ice ridges along its body. Beside it, on a rounded white snow-and-ice mound floating at the surface, place exactly four small arctic animals: three penguins standing upright in a row, and one white polar bear standing to their right. The animals should look like delicate frosty ice sculptures with subtle realistic detail. Background: turquoise ocean, blurred beachgoers, distant low mountains, a vivid cloudless blue sky with a soft white cloud on the right, and intense summer sun rays and lens flare from the upper left. Use bright refreshing colors, sparkling highlights, shallow depth of field, macro photography perspective, high contrast between tropical heat and icy coolness, cinematic realism, no text, no logo, no watermark. Customize the drink as emerald green, the main icy creature as breaching blue whale, the arctic animal group as three penguins and one polar bear, the setting as sunny tropical beach, and the lighting mood as brilliant midday sun with lens flare.
